name: Long Drive
summary: An anniversary page where a little retro car drives your years together, stopping at a postcard for each one
about: A retro road-trip anniversary page: the hills slide up, the road draws itself and a mustard coupe drives from your first year to home, pausing at signposts while a postcard tells each memory. The sky turns from day to sunset as the years go by (or from night to dawn in dark mode), and the drive ends at a little house that sends up heart balloons. Write both names and four stops, then send the link so your person gets the drive made for them.
how: Open the page: the hills rise, the road draws in and the car starts driving by itself.
At each signpost the car stops and a postcard shows that year's memory; the sky changes as the years pass.
Use the play, back and next buttons, drag the road slider, or tap a signpost to jump to a year.
Tap the car to honk and send up a few hearts; at the last stop the house sends up heart balloons.
In Make yours, type both names, four years with a memory each and a line for today, then copy the link.
